title: Buchtel vs. East — Football (2025–2026)
summary: A four-point finish and defensive resolve help the Dragons take a crucial October road win.
article_headline: East Holds Off Buchtel 12–8 in Akron City Series Battle
article_dek: A four-point finish and defensive resolve help the Dragons take a crucial October road win.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — East defeated Buchtel 12–8 on October 18, 2025, in a tightly contested Akron City Series football meeting at Buchtel Stadium. The Dragons protected a four-point margin to secure an important victory late in the regular season.

After the game, East players described a slow start and credited defensive effort, a turnover and improved momentum for helping the Dragons get through the contest. The result left little room for mistakes: one score separated the teams at the finish.

East went on to capture the 2025 City Series title the following week. The Buchtel game was a key hurdle on that road. Summit County Sports' gallery documents the matchup through Mason Bybee's original game photography.
article_highlights: East prevailed 12–8 on October 18, 2025, at Buchtel Stadium.
The Dragons held the Griffins to eight points in a one-possession matchup.
East players Emmanuel Jefferson, Marlin Engram Jr. and Anthony Felding III spoke after the victory about overcoming a slow start and creating momentum through defense.
